info.title: Vati Integration API
info.summary: Versioned Vati coordination boundary for cases, evidence, entities, findings, investigations and evidence requests, AI briefings, finding feedback and taxpayer assistance.
info.description: Proposed Vati routes (TAX-018). These are Vati contracts, not claims about Jube, Frappe, OpenAleph, yente, Docling or LangGraph endpoints. Jube is the operational case authority; Frappe owns users, submissions, evidence requests and approved decisions; Vati stores cross-service links, idempotency and delivery state. Tenant context is resolved from the authenticated principal; the X-Vati-Tenant-ID header selects a tenant and must fall inside the principal's permitted scope. Case IDs alone never authorise access. No route performs tax assessment, refund denial/payment, enforcement or referral outside the tax office (a specialist referral is an internal officer review). Synthetic data only.

servers.description: Reserved local development port for the future Vati API implementation. Not running in TAX-018.

get.summary: Read who is signed in and which Vati Workspace apps and views they may use.
get.description: TAX-146 (ADR-044). The signed-in officer, the selected tenant and the officer's roles in it, and the workspace apps and views the server permits. The app shell builds its tabs and sidebar from this, so navigation follows the server-side access scope; the server still enforces every operation on its own. An app the officer may use but that is not connected yet (the native investigation and explore screens until TAX-106) is listed as unavailable with a reason, never as a working link. Apps and views the officer may not use are absent.

get.summary: List case projections visible to the caller, such as the officer's assigned queue.
get.description: Returns only cases inside the selected tenant that the authenticated principal may see (TAX-029). assigned_to=me resolves the officer from the principal, never from client input. Filters narrow the visible set; they never widen it. Each case carries its selection reasons and a taxpayer summary so a queue renders without one request per row.

200.description: Case page; an empty page is a valid, non-error result.

post.summary: Register a Frappe submission as a case and request the matching Jube case.
post.description: Called by the Frappe server after submission validation. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key with an identical request digest returns the original response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; a changed digest returns 422 idempotency_conflict; a concurrent retry while the original is still running returns 409 idempotency_in_progress. The returned case is a projection; Jube remains the operational authority.

get.summary: Read the case projection and its cross-service links.
Read the case reference card: RSL claim, TIN (masked), RSL audit case, Vati case, Jube case and OpenAleph collection.
get.description: Read-only, from the canonical reference register (Vati Service Link). Same case.read and refund-confidentiality rules as getCase.

post.summary: Queue an approved LangGraph investigation run for the case.
post.description: Asynchronous: returns 202 with a run that has a finite deadline. The run drafts findings, alternatives and evidence gaps only; consequential actions stop at a human checkpoint.

get.summary: List permission-scoped evidence metadata and provenance for the case.

post.summary: Register an original document already held in the Frappe evidence store and queue extraction.
post.description: Vati never receives arbitrary URLs or full document bodies here. The caller supplies the restricted Frappe file reference and SHA-256 of the original; extraction (Docling) is asynchronous. Evidence is append-only; corrections set supersedes_evidence_id.

get.summary: List FtM-shaped entities linked to the case with unreviewed or reviewed match candidates.
get.description: Match candidates are proposals with dataset version; similarity is never identity or wrongdoing.

get.summary: List findings separating facts, inference, evidence gaps, legal-route status and proposed human actions.

post.summary: Record an officer-authorised evidence request in Frappe for the taxpayer.
post.description: The authenticated officer is the authorising actor; the request references the findings that justify it. Frappe owns the request record; Vati returns the pending synchronisation link. A failed Frappe write is reported as sync failure, never as a sent request.

202.description: Evidence request recorded; Frappe synchronisation state included.

get.summary: Read the officer review state of a case: review version, open decision, the viewer's permitted actions and the review trail.
get.description: Projection of the Frappe decision records (TAX-046, ADR-013). case_version counts recorded review actions and is the expected_version for proposeDecision, reviewDecision and requestEvidence. viewer.allowed_actions is a hint for the screen; every action is authorised again when sent. decision.approve is listed only when an open proposal exists that the viewer did not make.

post.summary: Propose an officer decision on a case. Nothing is sent to Jube until a different supervisor approves it.
post.description: The authenticated officer is the proposer. The outcome comes from a fixed list; none assesses tax, decides or pays a refund, accuses or refers anyone outside the tax office. refer_to_specialist also needs specialist.refer. Closing outcomes cite at least one evidence item or finding. A stale expected_version, a Jube status other than expected_case_status, or another open decision on the case returns 409 version_conflict with field_errors (stale_case_version, case_state_changed, decision_pending). Agent suggestions are never decisions: an officer proposes in their own words.

201.description: Decision proposed and waiting for approval.

post.summary: Approve, reject or withdraw a proposed decision. Approval runs the decision's one Jube operation.
post.description: approve and reject need a supervisor who is not the proposer (403 forbidden otherwise); withdraw is the proposer's. reject needs a reason. An agent draft is never approved (422 invalid_domain_input, agent_only_decision). A stale expected_version, an expired proposal or a case moved in Jube since the proposal returns 409 version_conflict (stale_case_version, proposal_expired, case_state_changed). A failed Jube call is returned as jube_sync.state failed, never as applied.

200.description: Review recorded; for an approval, the Jube synchronisation result is included.

get.summary: Read the taxpayer context an officer needs to review a case.
get.description: Read-only projection of the Frappe taxpayer record (Frappe is the authority), limited to review context: identifiers are masked and no submission documents are returned. Visible only when the principal may see at least one of the taxpayer's cases in the selected tenant; otherwise 404, so existence is not disclosed.

get.summary: Read measured workload and assurance figures for supervisors.
get.description: Supervisor-only (TAX-029 Vati Supervisor role in the selected tenant); any other principal gets 403 forbidden with no data. Figures are measured from records, never estimated: workload and evidence are point-in-time, closures and ledger counts cover the window. Every ratio carries its denominator. Gaps are listed in missing_data. Reading the ledger is itself recorded (TAX-059).

get.summary: Read the cited AI case briefing for an officer, with provenance, disclosure and checkpoint state.
get.description: Officer context only: auditor, specialist or supervisor of the tenant (taxpayers and other principals get 403 forbidden). Returns the briefing recorded once per run by ADR-021's validated workflow: every statement cites evidence (EvidenceRef), a search or an in-scope document; rejected statements are listed with a reason. decision, legal_conclusion and enforcement_conclusion are always null. 404 not_found when the case has no briefing yet or run_id is not one of its runs.

post.summary: Record an officer's accepted, modified or rejected judgement of a rule or agent finding.
post.description: auditor, specialist or supervisor of the tenant; taxpayers and service principals get 403 forbidden. The actor and role come from the session and are recorded. Append-only: a newer feedback by the same officer supersedes (previous_feedback_id) but never deletes the earlier one. Feedback never edits the finding, case or a decision and is not an approval: decisions still go through proposeDecision/reviewDecision by different officers (TAX-046). Officer-authored findings take no feedback (422 invalid_domain_input, officer_finding). Missing reason for modified/rejected: 422 reason_required; modified without text: modified_text_required; text without modified: modified_text_not_allowed. Same Idempotency-Key and body replays the stored feedback (Idempotent-Replayed: true); a changed body is 422 idempotency_conflict.

post.summary: Explain the deterministic pre-submission validation results of the taxpayer's own submission in plain language.
post.description: Recomputes the TAX-044/TAX-048 validation for the stored draft or correction-needed submission and returns it unchanged (validation) next to AI explanations with actionable steps. Explanations never change declared figures and never submit. A submission that is not the taxpayer's, or is already submitted, is 422 invalid_domain_input (submission_not_editable / not_found). Taxpayer context only (ADR-031): the caller must be the taxpayer named in the path, through its own membership in the header tenant. Another taxpayer's ID returns 404 not_found, reported exactly like a missing one; officers, specialists, supervisors and service principals get 403 forbidden. The response schema is taxpayer-facing and closed (additionalProperties false): it cannot carry risk scores, refund lanes, selection reasons, findings, case IDs, internal notes, officer identities or analysis provenance. Runs the taxpayer assistant (fast role; document role only for long documents) within a finite server budget of 25 seconds; on a timeout, rate limit or failed validation the router falls back to the deterministic template, so the call still answers and disclosure says so. The result and its provenance are stored; a replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the stored result without a model call.

post.summary: Document assistance: extracted fields the taxpayer should confirm and invoice rows flagged by deterministic checks.
post.description: Reads Docling output (TAX-038) of the taxpayer's own documents attached to the submission. Document text is untrusted data. Extracted values are proposals the taxpayer confirms or corrects in the form; nothing here changes the submission. Taxpayer context only (ADR-031): the caller must be the taxpayer named in the path, through its own membership in the header tenant. Another taxpayer's ID returns 404 not_found, reported exactly like a missing one; officers, specialists, supervisors and service principals get 403 forbidden. The response schema is taxpayer-facing and closed (additionalProperties false): it cannot carry risk scores, refund lanes, selection reasons, findings, case IDs, internal notes, officer identities or analysis provenance. Runs the taxpayer assistant (fast role; document role only for long documents) within a finite server budget of 25 seconds; on a timeout, rate limit or failed validation the router falls back to the deterministic template, so the call still answers and disclosure says so. The result and its provenance are stored; a replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the stored result without a model call.

200.description: Fields to confirm and flagged invoices.

post.summary: Draft a structured response to one of the taxpayer's own RSL evidence requests, saved as a draft only.
post.description: Explains the request in plain language, matches each item to documents the taxpayer already supplied and marks the rest missing. It never claims a document exists that does not and cites only the taxpayer's own documents. The request text is untrusted data. The draft is saved with status draft; nothing is sent until confirmEvidenceResponseDraft. A closed request is 422 invalid_domain_input (request_closed). Taxpayer context only (ADR-031): the caller must be the taxpayer named in the path, through its own membership in the header tenant. Another taxpayer's ID returns 404 not_found, reported exactly like a missing one; officers, specialists, supervisors and service principals get 403 forbidden. The response schema is taxpayer-facing and closed (additionalProperties false): it cannot carry risk scores, refund lanes, selection reasons, findings, case IDs, internal notes, officer identities or analysis provenance. Runs the taxpayer assistant (fast role; document role only for long documents) within a finite server budget of 25 seconds; on a timeout, rate limit or failed validation the router falls back to the deterministic template, so the call still answers and disclosure says so. The result and its provenance are stored; a replay with the same Idempotency-Key returns the stored result without a model call.

get.summary: Read one of the taxpayer's own evidence-response drafts.
get.description: No model call. Taxpayer context only (ADR-031): the caller must be the taxpayer named in the path, through its own membership in the header tenant. Another taxpayer's ID returns 404 not_found, reported exactly like a missing one; officers, specialists, supervisors and service principals get 403 forbidden. The response schema is taxpayer-facing and closed (additionalProperties false): it cannot carry risk scores, refund lanes, selection reasons, findings, case IDs, internal notes, officer identities or analysis provenance.

post.summary: The taxpayer's explicit confirmation: send the (possibly edited) answers as their TAX-045 evidence response.
post.description: The only step that sends anything to RSL. Separate, audited and idempotent: same Idempotency-Key and body replays the confirmation; a changed body is 422 idempotency_conflict; a stale expected_version (the draft changed or was already confirmed with another key) is 409 version_conflict with current_version. Attached evidence must be the taxpayer's own and not attached to another request (422 invalid_domain_input, TAX-045 rules). No model call. Taxpayer context only (ADR-031): the caller must be the taxpayer named in the path, through its own membership in the header tenant. Another taxpayer's ID returns 404 not_found, reported exactly like a missing one; officers, specialists, supervisors and service principals get 403 forbidden. The response schema is taxpayer-facing and closed (additionalProperties false): it cannot carry risk scores, refund lanes, selection reasons, findings, case IDs, internal notes, officer identities or analysis provenance.

200.description: Draft confirmed and the evidence response recorded.

get.summary: Read restricted policy-gap and integrity aggregates for supervisors.
get.description: Supervisor-only (TAX-029 Vati Supervisor role in the selected tenant); any other principal gets 403 forbidden with no data. Aggregates only: cells covering fewer than min_group_size people are combined, and no officer or taxpayer is identified. Policy exposure is about the rules, never taxpayer noncompliance; review signals are prompts, never accusations. Reading the ledger is itself recorded (TAX-059).

bearerAuth.description: Opaque session or service token. Issuance and role/tenant mapping are implemented by TAX-029; browser code never holds vendor secrets.

WindowDaysQuery.name: window_days
WindowDaysQuery.description: Reporting window in days, 1-365, ending at generated_at. Default 30.

TenantHeader.name: X-Vati-Tenant-ID
TenantHeader.description: Tenant selected for this request. Must fall inside the authenticated principal's permitted scope; otherwise 403 tenant_scope_denied. Missing or malformed: 400 missing_tenant_context.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Client-generated unique key per logical mutation. Missing: 400 invalid_request. Stored with a request digest; same key and digest replays the original response, changed digest returns 422 idempotency_conflict, original still in progress returns 409 idempotency_in_progress.

CorrelationIdHeader.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationIdHeader.description: Optional caller correlation ID; generated when absent and always echoed.

CaseIdPath.name: case_id
CaseIdPath.description: Internal immutable case UUID. Missing or malformed: 400 invalid_case_id. Never sufficient for authorisation alone.

AssignedToQuery.name: assigned_to
AssignedToQuery.description: me: cases assigned to the authenticated officer (resolved server-side). unassigned: cases without an officer. Omitted: every case the principal may see.

RefundLaneQuery.name: refund_lane
RefundLaneQuery.description: Only cases in this refund lane.

TaxpayerIdPath.name: taxpayer_id
TaxpayerIdPath.description: Internal immutable taxpayer UUID. Missing or malformed: 400 invalid_request. Never sufficient for authorisation alone.

DecisionIdPath.name: decision_id
DecisionIdPath.description: Decision UUID; must belong to the case in the path. Missing or malformed: 400 invalid_request.

FindingIdPath.name: finding_id
FindingIdPath.description: Finding UUID; must belong to the case in the path. Missing or malformed: 400 invalid_request.

DraftIdPath.name: draft_id
DraftIdPath.description: Assistant draft UUID; must belong to the taxpayer in the path. Missing or malformed: 400 invalid_request.

RunIdQuery.name: run_id
RunIdQuery.description: A specific investigation run of this case; default the latest run with a briefing.

IdempotentReplayed.description: Present with value true when the stored original response is replayed.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, missing tenant context or missing/invalid case ID.

NotFound.description: Resource missing or concealed from this principal.

Conflict.description: Stale expected_version (version_conflict), or the original request for this Idempotency-Key is still in progress (idempotency_in_progress).

InvalidDomainInput.description: Well-formed request that cannot be processed: a domain rule is violated (invalid_domain_input), or the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request digest (idempotency_conflict).

DependencyUnavailable.description: Required upstream unavailable or timed out. Never replaced by fixture data or an invented result; timeouts mean unknown outcome.

RslServiceName.description: RSL system a case refers to (TAX-133, ADR-052). Vati reads from or refers to these systems and never writes to them through a link.

ServiceLink.description: Cross-service mapping row; unique on (tenant_id, service, external_id).

external_id.description: Null until the upstream has acknowledged creation.

CaseStatus.description: UI projection of the configured Jube workflow; not an independent lifecycle.

selection_reasons.description: RSL's selection reasons and scores (source: an RSL system), then any Vati corroborating signals, in priority order. Empty when none are recorded.

CaseAttention.description: Optional, computed by the server from its own records (TAX-147), so queue views and counts never guess. A server that cannot compute it omits it, and clients then show no count. Overdue means an outstanding evidence request (recorded or sent, not answered) is past its due date.

decision_awaiting_approval.description: A proposed decision is waiting for a supervisor who did not propose it.

evidence_due_date.description: Earliest due date of the outstanding evidence requests.

CaseReferences.description: The case reference card (TAX-133): every identifier of one case the caller may see, from the canonical reference register. A reference the caller may not see is null (or an empty list) exactly like one that is not mapped.

audience.description: Whose view of the card this is; officers see every reference.

tin_masked.description: The taxpayer's TIN with all but the last digits masked; the full TIN is never on the card.

rsl_claim_id.description: The claim in RSL's Online Refunds Application this case is about.

rsl_audit_case_ref.description: The RSL audit system case that referred this case.

openaleph_collection_id.description: The OpenAleph collection holding the case's evidence; officers only.

rsl_records.description: Other RSL records the case relies on (returns, invoices, customs entries, PSRM records), sorted; officers only.

rsl_records_truncated.description: True when the case maps more RSL records than the card lists.

SelectionReason.description: Why RSL selected the case, labelled with the RSL system it came from (its reasons and scores stay RSL's), or a Vati signal that corroborates or questions RSL's selection (TAX-131, ADR-043). Vati selects no case and produces no risk score. Never a finding, assessment, accusation or decision.

source.description: An RSL system for RSL's own reasons and scores; a Vati service for a corroborating signal.

TaxpayerSummary.description: Minimal taxpayer context embedded in a case; taxpayer_id equals the case's taxpayer_id.

TaxpayerProfile.description: Read-only Frappe taxpayer projection for review context. open_cases lists only cases the principal may see.

tin_masked.description: Taxpayer identification number with all but the last digits masked; null when not on record.

frappe_submission_ref.description: Frappe document name of the validated submission.

analysis_provenance.description: TAX-096. One entry per model call the run has made so far, in order. Optional; empty while queued.

frappe_file_ref.description: Restricted Frappe File name; never a public or arbitrary URL.

MatchCandidate.description: yente proposal. Score is a decimal string in [0,1]; it is never identity, wrongdoing or legal authority.

ftm_schema.description: Selected FtM schema; mapping validated in TAX-036.

LegalRoute.description: Remains unverified until a qualified reviewer supplies an authoritative citation.

producer.description: vati_check (TAX-121, ADR-042): a deterministic Vati assurance check run by the platform pipeline; it names its check like a rule.

analysis_provenance.description: TAX-096. Present for langgraph_run findings; null for jube_rule and officer findings. Optional for backward compatibility.

feedback_summary.description: TAX-096. Officer feedback so far; null for officer findings. Optional for backward compatibility.

source_refs.description: TAX-121. RSL source records the check read (ADR-040 references, never copies). Optional for backward compatibility.

candidate_route.description: TAX-121. The TAX-116 candidate legal anchors or policy gaps the finding code routes to; unverified and never eligible for assessment. legal_route stays unverified (no_verified_route for a policy gap) with no citation. Optional for backward compatibility.

RslSourceRef.description: Reference to one record read from an RSL source system through its TAX-111 contract (fixture until RSL supplies a specification).

CandidateRoute.description: TAX-116 rule-register routing of a finding code. Every candidate is unverified until RSL Legal reviews it.

DecisionOutcome.description: The only outcomes a decision can carry (ADR-013, TAX-042). Each runs one Jube operation after approval. refer_to_specialist is an internal review by a specialist officer, never a referral outside the tax office.

ReviewPermission.description: TAX-029 action names a reviewer may hold on a case.

JubeSync.description: Result of the decision's one Jube operation. Jube is the case authority; status_after is what Jube reported.

Decision.description: An officer decision recorded in Frappe (ADR-013). proposed_by and reviewed_by are officer IDs; reviewed_by is never the proposer for an approval.

rating.description: Investigator rating Jube records with the case update (ADR-009); not a risk verdict.

ReviewEvent.description: One append-only review trail entry (Vati Audit Event, ADR-013).

sequence.description: Case version this action took; null for Jube results.

case_version.description: Send as expected_version with the next review action.

Ratio.description: A measured proportion. The rate is numerator / denominator. A denominator of 0 means there is nothing to measure: show 'no data', never 0%.

DurationStats.description: Elapsed-time distribution measured from case timestamps.

excluded.description: Records in scope that lacked a needed timestamp and were not measured.

median_hours.description: Hours as a decimal string with one decimal place; null when count is 0.

p90_hours.description: Nearest-rank 90th percentile; null when count is 0.

max_hours.description: Hours as a decimal string with one decimal place; null when count is 0.

ManagementSummary.description: Management workload and assurance measures for one tenant, computed from case, decision, evidence-request, finding and audit-ledger records. Counts only: no taxpayer or document content, and no per-officer integrity detail.

open_cases.description: Cases not RESOLVED, as projected from Jube.

open_case_age.description: generated_at minus created_at for open cases.

time_to_close.description: Closure time minus created_at for cases closed in the window.

unresolved_evidence.description: Point-in-time evidence requests (Frappe is the authority).

outstanding_requests.description: Evidence requests recorded or sent and not yet responded to or withdrawn.

overdue_requests.description: Outstanding requests whose due date is before generated_at.

closure_outcomes.description: Cases closed in the window, by approved decision outcome (TAX-046).

without_recorded_outcome.description: Closed cases with no approved decision outcome; excluded from both ratios.

no_further_action.description: Closed with close_no_further_action over closed cases with a recorded outcome: selected cases where review found nothing to correct (false positives). A measure of selection, never a judgement on an officer or taxpayer.

after_correction.description: Closed with close_after_correction over the same denominator.

verified_by_reviewer.description: Findings whose legal route a reviewer verified, over all findings on open cases and cases closed in the window.

no_verified_route.description: Findings with no verified legal route (policy gap).

assurance.description: Audit ledger assurance from the TAX-059 ledger reads for the window. Signals are review prompts, never findings; signals about the viewing supervisor are withheld and only counted.

missing_data.description: Known gaps in the measured data, so the view never presents a partial number as complete.

WorkspaceSession.description: The signed-in officer's scope for the app shell (TAX-146). Navigation only: it never grants access by itself.

apps.description: Workspace apps this officer may use, in display order. Absent means not permitted.

views.description: Views inside the Cases and Reports apps this officer may open.

reason.description: Why an app is unavailable; null when available.

ModelRole.description: get_model role (ADR-031). Agents choose a role, never a provider.

ModelProvider.description: Provider that produced the output. mock: keyless deterministic fixture provider (CI and development). ollama: local open-weights model. template: deterministic template, the last fallback.

FallbackLevelName.description: Level of the per-call fallback chain that produced the output: hosted model (or mock in keyless mode), local model, deterministic template.

TokenUsage.description: Token use reported by the provider; null when the provider does not report it. Template output uses no tokens.

status.description: Result of the output validator for the level that was used. failed output is never returned as a finding; the call falls back instead.

rejected_statements.description: Statements the validator removed (briefings). Omitted when not applicable.

ProvenanceAttempt.description: One level tried for this call. Every skipped or failed level is listed, so a fallback is never hidden.

outcome.description: ok, or why the call moved on: rate_limited, timeout, refusal, invalid_output, validation_failed, unconfigured, provider_error, call_budget_exhausted, token_budget_exhausted, input_budget_exceeded, ...

AnalysisProvenance.description: How an AI output was produced (ADR-031): provider, model, role, prompt version, settings, fallback level, latency, token use and validation result. Recorded for officer audit; never shown to taxpayers (they see AiDisclosure only). Deterministic rule output has no provenance (null).

model_id.description: Model that actually produced the output (observed ID when the provider reports one), or the template ID.

configured_model_id.description: Model configured for the level used; null when the role is unconfigured.

task.description: Router task name, e.g. case_briefing, validation_explanation.

settings.description: Generation settings of the level used (temperature, response format, output-token and timeout limits). Scalar values only; a fractional temperature is a decimal string such as "0.2".

fell_back.description: True when any earlier level was tried and not used.

router_version.description: Model router version (TAX-089); null for output recorded before the router existed.

AiDisclosure.description: Model-versus-template disclosure shown next to every AI-produced item, for officers and taxpayers.

source.description: What a UI must disclose: hosted model, local model, deterministic template or keyless fixture. Derived from fallback_level_name (hosted -> hosted_model, local -> local_model, template -> template, mock -> mock_fixture).

advisory_only.description: AI output is a suggestion. It never decides, assesses tax or changes declared figures.

FindingFeedbackReasonCode.description: Structured reason for the TAX-070 feedback loop; the free-text reason explains it.

FindingFeedbackRequest.description: The actor is taken from the authenticated session, never from the body.

reason.description: Required (at least 10 characters) for modified and rejected; optional for accepted. Otherwise 422 invalid_domain_input, field_errors code reason_required.

modified_explanation.description: The officer's corrected wording. Required for modified (modified_text_required) and must be null otherwise (modified_text_not_allowed).

FindingSnapshot.description: What was judged: the finding's producer and provenance when the feedback was recorded.

FindingFeedback.description: One append-only officer judgement of a rule or agent finding (TAX-086 stores it; TAX-070 reads it).

previous_feedback_id.description: The same officer's earlier feedback on this finding, which this one supersedes. Both stay in the append-only record.

changes_finding.description: Feedback never edits the finding, the case or a decision, and is not an approval.

FindingFeedbackSummary.description: Counts of each officer's latest verdict on this finding.

viewer_verdict.description: The requesting officer's latest verdict, or null.

citation_id.description: <evidence_id>#<extraction item id> from the permitted evidence search.

BriefingSearchRef.description: A search the run performed (used to report missing information).

BriefingDocumentRef.description: An in-scope document as a whole (for example one that could not be searched).

BriefingStatement.description: A validated briefing statement. Every statement resolves to evidence, a search or an in-scope document of this run.

action.description: Set only for next_action statements; always a proposal for an officer.

items.description: <evidence_id>#<extraction item id> from the permitted evidence search.

BriefingRejectedStatement.description: A drafted statement the validator removed, kept so an officer can see what was dropped and why.

resume_requires.description: The run resumes only with an approved TAX-046 decision for this exact action digest (TAX-047).

BriefingCheckpoint.description: Human-checkpoint state of the run that produced the briefing.

CaseBriefing.description: Cited officer briefing recorded once per run (ADR-021). Officer context only.

instruction_like_items.description: Evidence items whose text looked like instructions; flagged for the officer, never followed.

TaxpayerFacingIssueCode.description: Deterministic pre-submission issue codes shown to taxpayers (TAX-044 allowlist plus the TAX-098 checks). Nothing outside this list reaches a taxpayer.

TaxpayerFacingDocumentRef.description: One of the requesting taxpayer's own documents. Never another taxpayer's or an officer upload.

invoice_number.description: 1-based row in the submission's invoice schedule; null for claim-level issues.

message.description: Fixed deterministic prompt text, not model output.

TaxpayerFacingFigures.description: Deterministic TAX-048 figures for the taxpayer's own claim (ADR-023). Never model output.

TaxpayerFacingValidationResult.description: Deterministic validation result, recomputed by the server from the stored submission; the UI shows it apart from AI explanations.

invoice_number.description: 1-based row in the submission's invoice schedule; null for claim-level issues.

suggested_steps.description: Actionable steps for the taxpayer, in order.

requires_taxpayer_confirmation.description: A suggestion: the taxpayer makes any correction in the form themselves.

TaxpayerFacingExplainValidationRequest.description: The taxpayer's own draft or correction-needed submission. Validation results are recomputed server-side; the client never supplies them.

extracted_value.description: Short plain value read from the document (amounts as decimal strings); null when not found.

declared_value.description: What the taxpayer entered, if anything.

TaxpayerFacingFlaggedInvoice.description: An invoice row with deterministic issues, explained for the taxpayer.

suggested_steps.description: Actionable steps for the taxpayer, in order.

evidence_ids.description: Subset of the submission's own documents; empty means all of them. Another taxpayer's or an unknown ID is 422 invalid_domain_input (not_found), reported the same way.

request_id.description: One of the taxpayer's own open evidence requests (TAX-045).

taxpayer_note.description: Optional context from the taxpayer. Treated as untrusted data, like the request text.

missing_explanation.description: What is still missing. A missing item never cites a document.

TaxpayerFacingConfirmedItem.description: The taxpayer's final answer to one item: their own documents, or a reason they cannot provide it (TAX-045 rules).

evidence_response_id.description: The TAX-045 evidence response created on confirmation.

TaxpayerFacingEvidenceResponseDraft.description: An assistant-drafted evidence response. Saved as a draft only; nothing reaches RSL until the taxpayer confirms it.

status.description: draft: saved, nothing sent. confirmed: the taxpayer confirmed and the TAX-045 response was recorded. request_closed: the request was withdrawn or answered another way; the draft can no longer be confirmed.

request_summary.description: Plain-language summary of what RSL asked for.

TaxpayerFacingConfirmDraftRequest.description: The taxpayer's final, possibly edited answers. Every requested item needs one of their own documents or a reason (422 invalid_domain_input otherwise).

declaration.description: The taxpayer confirms the answers are theirs and correct.

IntegrityRow.description: One aggregate cell. It covers at least min_group_size people (taxpayers, or both recording supervisors and affected officers). No person is identified.

IntegrityCombinedRow.description: Cells too small to show alone, combined (with the smallest visible cells if needed) so no small cell can be derived from the total.

IntegrityUnavailable.description: This source could not be read in this environment (the audit ledger, or the case findings store before TAX-086); see missing_data.

PolicyExposure.description: Reviewer-confirmed findings without a verified legal route (TAX-052), by policy area. About the rules, never a finding of taxpayer noncompliance. insufficient_volume returns no counts.

IntegrityReview.description: Restricted management review of policy gaps and integrity patterns (TAX-077, ADR-036). Aggregates only; no person is identified.

override_patterns.description: TAX-059 control overrides in the window, by control. Describes how controls are used, never an officer's conduct.

review_signals.description: TAX-059 review signals counted by kind. Subjects are never returned; signals about the viewer are withheld and only counted.

message.description: Safe summary; never document content, credentials or stack traces.

EventEnvelope.description: Internal outbox event. Payloads reference restricted IDs; never embed full documents.
